external_invariants: Model architecture frozen: GPT-2 124M FP32 (n_layer=12, n_embd=768, n_head=12, vocab_size=50257, n_positions=1024) with resid_pdrop=embd_pdrop=attn_pdrop=0.0, use_cache=False and attn_implementation='eager', in train mode.

Deterministic seeds preserved: torch.manual_seed(20261020) for model construction (called in configure and again in make_model exactly as the source does) and torch.Generator().manual_seed(31000 + source_rank) for each rank's accumulation_steps synthetic token-ID batches of shape (micro_batch, sequence_length).
Numerical policies preserved: TF32 disabled for matmul and cudnn, cudnn.benchmark=False, float32 matmul precision 'highest', torch.set_num_threads(4), set_num_interop_threads(1).

DDP configuration preserved: bucket_cap_mb=25, gradient_as_bucket_view=True, broadcast_buffers=False on the NCCL default process group initialized by the worker; the adapter never calls init_process_group and never installs a communication hook in the measured path.

Accumulation semantics preserved: loss divided by accumulation_steps, backward per micro-batch, no_sync on the first accumulation_steps-1 micro-batches and the synchronized gradient all-reduce on the final one, so the reduced gradients equal the serial global-batch (world_size*micro_batch*accumulation_steps = 8) average.
Optimizer semantics preserved: torch.optim.SGD(lr=0.001, momentum=0.0, weight_decay=0.0, foreach=False) applied once per step after the accumulation.
Timed-boundary division preserved: optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) executes inside run() at the start of accumulate(), not in reset(); the step ends with torch.cuda.synchronize() inside run().

Correctness checks preserved with source tolerances: finite loss; global-batch gradient and parameter-update checks against the serial reference at atol=1e-6/rtol=1e-4; cross-rank gradient replica equality at atol=0.0, rtol=0.0; the +1 corruption negative control must be rejected.
Step-time constraint preserved: clean step time (max across ranks of per-rank wall time) must stay <= 1.05x the original baseline (goals.constraints.step_ms_max_baseline_ratio).

Communication metric definition preserved: per-rank sum of device NCCL kernel durations in a separately profiled invocation, maximum across ranks, median of 3 profiled samples; it includes device waiting and is not wire time, exposed communication or a critical-path bound; profiling is separate from clean timing.

Workload dimensions (world_size, micro_batch, sequence_length, accumulation_steps) are read from request['workload'] in prepare(), never embedded as constants, so the held-out longer_sequence variant (sequence_length=256, accumulation_steps=2) runs through the same adapter; the bucket-inventory hook pass of the source is a diagnostic owned by the framework and is not part of run().
